NFL DFS Running Back Rankings: Week 11 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 22 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 19, 11:20 AM ET

Jahmyr Gibbs is the top-projected running back on the Week 11 DraftKings main slate at 27.0 DraftKings points for $10,000, against Tampa Bay. Emmett Johnson (22.2, $6,000) and James Cook III (20.7, $7,900) are next.

Emmett Johnson returns the most per dollar among running backs projected for at least 9 points: 3.71 projected points per $1,000 at $6,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 19, 11:20 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Running backs to know in Week 11

Jahmyr Gibbs, DET vs TB ($10,000)

Jahmyr Gibbs carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 27.0 DraftKings points at $10,000, the highest on the entire main slate. That is 4.8 points clear of Emmett Johnson. The model gives him 22.3 carries and 5.1 targets. The salary works out to 2.70 projected points per $1,000, 3rd of 22 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Gibbs averaged 27.0 points with a simulated floor of 14.9 and a ceiling of 44.4, and he holds 22% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 7-point favorite at home against Tampa Bay, with an implied team total of 25.25 in a game totaled at 43.5.

Emmett Johnson, KC vs ARI ($6,000)

Emmett Johnson projects 2nd at the position with 22.2 DraftKings points at $6,000, 4th on the main slate overall. The model gives him 12.1 carries and 2.5 targets. The salary works out to 3.71 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 22 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Johnson averaged 22.1 points with a simulated floor of 10.1 and a ceiling of 40.1, and he holds 67% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Kansas City is a 15.5-point favorite at home against Arizona, with an implied team total of 28 in a game totaled at 40.5.

James Cook III, BUF vs MIA ($7,900)

James Cook III projects 3rd at the position with 20.7 DraftKings points at $7,900. The model gives him 21.4 carries and 2.1 targets. The salary works out to 2.62 projected points per $1,000, 7th of 22 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Cook averaged 20.8 points with a simulated floor of 8.7 and a ceiling of 39.2, and he holds 16% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Buffalo is a 16.5-point favorite at home against Miami, with an implied team total of 30.5 in a game totaled at 44.5.

Value: Ashton Jeanty, LV at DEN ($5,500)

Ashton Jeanty projects for 13.1 DraftKings points at $5,500, which works out to 2.38 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 22 running backs the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 9.9 carries and 5.8 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Jeanty averaged 13.0 points with a simulated floor of 3.4 and a ceiling of 29.0, and he holds 4% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Las Vegas is a 10-point underdog on the road against Denver, with an implied team total of 15.25 in a game totaled at 40.5.
